observed_gate_rejection.root_cause: authorization absence was encoded as a common source-phase fixture invariant, so the intended live-authorization test body was unreachable when authorization correctly existed

safe_post_failure_diagnostic.source_probe_live_result: rejected because the probe also hardcoded authorization absence
safe_post_failure_diagnostic.live_authorization_body_result: rejected because dependency hashes were computed outside the successor binding domain
safe_post_failure_diagnostic.lifecycle_postcondition_result: rejected because it also hardcoded authorization absence
safe_post_failure_diagnostic.runner_guard_postcondition_result: rejected because it also hardcoded authorization absence

phase_contract.common_phase: validate immutable retained evidence, closed predecessor lifecycles, fresh result/attempt/launch absence, and one exact repository-derived authorization tag without asserting authorization absence
phase_contract.preauthorization: require the fresh authorization path absent by lexists and absent from both the HEAD tree and index
phase_contract.live_authorization: require the exact regular non-symlink non-reparse authorization, committed-blob equality, sole-child ancestry, exact changed paths, and an explicit live-branch execution receipt
phase_contract.third_state: reject every checkout that is neither exact preauthorization nor exact live authorization
phase_contract.phase_stability: snapshot the complete authorization tag before every wrapper or probe and require exact equality afterward
phase_contract.source_probe: run unchanged in both valid states and report the complete authorization tag instead of asserting timeless absence
phase_contract.dependency_domain: produce and validate dependency hashes only inside the complete fresh-successor binding context and reject missing, extra, or inherited-domain sets
phase_contract.test_matrix: exercise every phase-neutral control in both isolated states, every phase-specific control in its exact state, and the real checkout branch with explicit counters and zero skips
required_crossover_mutations: authorization dangling or non-regular in authorized phase
authorization reparse or symlink in authorized phase
authorization working bytes differ from committed blob
authorization phase label differs from observed filesystem state
